title: Traces table grouped sessions across result pages: session aggregates are blanked via sessionsMayBeIncomplete; new flags must be forwarded through TracesTableView
answers: Token total for a grouped session changes between pages of the V4 Traces table
Why are session-level values hidden in grouped traces when the results have more than one page?
How do I pass a new option from the V4 Traces page down to the traces table?
body:
Path: Grouped-by-session traces on the V4 Traces page. TracesV4PageContent.tsx:TracesV4PageContent sets sessionsMayBeIncomplete from controller.isGroupedBySession and page hasNext or hasPrev. It goes through TracesTableView.tsx:TracesTableView into TracesTable.tsx:TracesTable, which decides whether each session row shows renderSessionCell output.
Rule: Session aggregates are computed only from traces loaded on the current page, and a session can straddle pages (the grouped query is capped at 500 traces). When sessionsMayBeIncomplete is true, TracesTable renders null for every session-level column, in both header-row branches. The first and state cells are unaffected. A new table option that must reach TracesTable has to be declared in TracesTableViewProps and forwarded explicitly; the first draft missed this, which broke type-checking and left the suppression inactive.
Symptom: A session that crossed a page boundary showed a different, partial token subtotal on each page, with nothing indicating it was partial.
Constraints: Applies only to grouped-by-session results with more than one page. Ungrouped rows and single-page results keep their aggregates. The suppression is blanket, so a future aggregate that is already complete per page is hidden too.
applies: Grouped-by-session traces on the V4 Traces page with pagination, and any session-level aggregate column.
says: Grouped session totals disappear from the traces table when results have multiple pages
Session token counts show conflicting partial values across different result pages
Why are session summary columns blank when viewing paginated grouped traces
Grouped trace sessions spanning across page boundaries display misleading partial totals
Token aggregates are missing from session header rows on paginated trace tables
search: When grouped-by-session traces on the V4 Traces page span multiple pages, TracesV4PageContent.tsx:TracesV4PageContent sets sessionsMayBeIncomplete, which TracesTable.tsx:TracesTable receives via TracesTableView.tsx:TracesTableView to render null for all session-level aggregate columns. This suppression prevents displaying misleading partial token totals when sessions straddle page boundaries within the 500-trace query cap, while leaving the first and state cells visible. New table options must be explicitly declared in TracesTableViewProps and forwarded through TracesTableView; single-page grouped results and ungrouped rows retain their aggregates.
